tool.name: pmotools validate_pmo
tool.description: Validate a PMO file against the JSON schema
tool.command: pmotools-python validate_pmo --pmo '$input_pmo' #if str($jsonschema_source.jsonschema_source_selector) == "version": --jsonschema_version '$jsonschema_source.jsonschema_version' #elif str($jsonschema_source.jsonschema_source_selector) == "file": --jsonschema_file '$jsonschema_source.jsonschema_file' #end if && echo "PMO is valid" > '$output_log'

param.name: jsonschema_version
param.label: Schema version
param.help: Version of the JSON schema to validate against

param.name: jsonschema_file
param.label: Custom JSON schema file
param.help: Explicit JSON schema file to validate against (overrides version)

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Validate PMO**
Validates a Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO) JSON file against the official PMO JSON schema. The tool will report whether the file conforms to the schema and identify any validation errors.
**Input**
- A PMO JSON file (optionally gzipped)
**Options**
- **Schema source**: Choose between a built-in schema version (1.1.0 or 1.0.0) or provide a custom JSON schema file. - **Schema version**: The version of the PMO JSON schema to validate against (default: 1.1.0).
**Output**
- If validation succeeds, a log file confirming the PMO is valid is produced. - If validation fails, the tool exits with a non-zero exit code and reports the validation errors in stderr.
